tools.name: flop_check_htlc
tools.description: Check the status of an HTLC by its hash lock. Returns CREATED, SETTLED, or REFUNDED.

tools.name: flop_trust_root
tools.description: Read-only canonical trust base: allowed TDX measurements (dstack VKs), registered models, SKU ceilings, evidence params, and active PoUI committee. Pin snapshotHash to detect governance-gated drift across upgrades.

tools.name: flop_verify_tee_quote
tools.description: Simulated check of a TEE (Trusted Execution Environment) quote/attestation (Intel SGX or AWS Nitro). Performs no cryptographic verification: always returns verified: false, status: 'unverified', simulated: true, and placeholder quote details.

quote_hex.description: TEE quote or attestation data as hex string

tee_type.description: TEE type: 'intel-sgx' for Intel SGX quotes, 'aws-nitro' for AWS Nitro attestations, or 'auto' to detect automatically

tcb_response_hex.description: Intel TCB response data as hex (required for Intel SGX verification)

tools.name: flop_get_tcb_status
tools.description: Get TCB (Trusted Computing Base) status and security advisories for Intel SGX or other TEE platforms. Check for known vulnerabilities and recommended updates.

platform.description: TEE platform to check TCB status for

tcb_version.description: Specific TCB version to check (e.g., SVN for Intel SGX)

tools.name: flop_get_inference_receipt
tools.description: Get a settled HTLC's authenticated TEE quote digest and verified compute. Other receipt fields are placeholders and do not establish model or input/output commitments or finalized settlement.
